name: rewrite-foundation-verification
description: Verify the first Drogon rewrite slice on a clean checkout. This does not implement deferred features or certify migration completion. Run only after coordinator integration; never concurrently with source-editing workers. Uses deterministic local builds and tests, not model inference.

steps.label: clean-checkout
steps.prompt: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" && node --version && cargo --version && pnpm --version && printf 'CHECKOUT_READY\n'

steps.label: build-and-test
steps.prompt: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cargo build --workspace --locked && cargo test --workspace --locked && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @drogon/desktop test && pnpm --filter @drogon/desktop build && printf 'BUILD_VERIFIED\n'

commands: test -f apps/desktop/out/main/index.js && test -f apps/desktop/out/renderer/index.html && test -x target/debug/drogond && test -x target/debug/drogon-cli
node --check scripts/accept-desktop.mjs && git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet
